hero.lead: Running biuro@, kontakt@ and your own name on a domain hosted at cyber_Folks? Connect each mailbox to one workspace and your AI agent works across all of them. Read, search, send, reply, schedule and organize mail over IMAP, with the password of the mailbox rather than your cyber_Folks customer login.
hero.answer: Claude cannot reach a cyber_Folks mailbox on its own. MCPEmails is a hosted MCP server that connects it over IMAP on port 993 to the server your account lives on, a name of the form s1.cyber-folks.pl, signing in with the full address and the mailbox password, so Claude, Cursor or any MCP client can read, search, send and organize the mail. cyber_Folks publishes the ports (993 for IMAP, 465 or 587 for SMTP) and tells you to read the server name from your own panel, under Dane konfiguracyjne in cyber_Admin. Sending goes through the same server, with authentication always required. One inbox is free, forever.

method.title: How cyber_Folks connects: your server's name, IMAP on 993 and SMTP on 465
method.body: cyber_Folks does not publish one shared mail host. Its help page says the incoming and outgoing server is the one your hosting account runs on, and that its name is shown in cyber_Admin under Dane konfiguracyjne, behind the gear icon in the top right corner, or in the Panel Klienta under Twoje usługi, Hosting, in the Host column. Those names follow the pattern s1.cyber-folks.pl, with your own number in place of the 1, and they carry a certificate for *.cyber-folks.pl: we opened TLS connections to three servers in the series and each answered IMAP on 993 with a Dovecot banner and SMTP on 465 and 587 with Exim. The ports cyber_Folks lists are 993 for IMAP, 465 for SMTP with SSL and 587 as the alternative, and it asks you not to use port 25. The username is the whole address, the password is the one set on the mailbox when it was created, and the outgoing server requires authentication: without it the server answers 550 relay not permitted, authentication required.

setup.p: Sign up at mcpemails.com. The free plan connects one mailbox, forever, and does not ask for a card.

setup.h: Read your server name in cyber_Admin
setup.p: Sign in to cyber_Admin, click the gear icon in the top right and open Dane konfiguracyjne. The IMAP and SMTP server shown there, a name like s1.cyber-folks.pl with your own number, is the one to enter. The same name is in the Panel Klienta under Twoje usługi, Hosting, in the Host column.

The password belongs to the individual mailbox, set when it was created under MAIL, LISTA KONT in cyber_Admin (or under Konta e-mail in DirectAdmin). It is not your Panel Klienta password. If you do not know it, set a new one on that mailbox; nothing else is affected.

setup.h: Enter them in MCPEmails and paste the MCP URL into your AI
setup.p: Choose IMAP / SMTP, enter the full address such as biuro@twojadomena.pl, the mailbox password and your server name, with 993 and SSL for IMAP and 465 and SSL for SMTP. Then drop https://mcpemails.com/api/mcp into Claude, Cursor or ChatGPT, authorize, and your agent has the mailbox.

gotchas.h: Use the cyber-folks.pl name, not mail.yourdomain.pl
gotchas.p: cyber_Folks' page explains that the server also answers under your own domain, as mail.twojadomena.pl, but that the certificate on the server is issued for the cyber_Folks name, so a client using the domain gets a certificate warning or a refused TLS connection. MCPEmails validates certificates and will not connect through a name the certificate does not cover. Use the sNN.cyber-folks.pl name from your panel, which is the one cyber_Folks itself recommends.

gotchas.h: The main mailbox of the account logs in with the hosting login
gotchas.p: Every mailbox you create logs in with its full address. The one exception cyber_Folks documents is the account's primary mailbox, whose username is the hosting login (its example is a short login such as lnxpl) rather than an address. If the address form is refused on that one mailbox, try the login from your hosting welcome email instead.

gotchas.h: AUTH=PLAIN only on IMAP, and no MOVE
gotchas.p: The Dovecot behind each server advertises AUTH=PLAIN alone on IMAP, which MCPEmails uses, while SMTP accepts both PLAIN and LOGIN. The pre-login capability list has no MOVE, UIDPLUS or SPECIAL-USE, so filing a message runs as a copy, a flag update and an expunge, and the sent, drafts and trash folders are matched by their names. On a Polish mailbox that often means Wysłane, Kopie robocze and Kosz; name the folder in your instruction if the agent cannot find it.

limits: The SMTP server announces a maximum message size of 100 MB. A forward carrying larger attachments is refused at send time.
Because the server does not advertise MOVE, a move is not atomic. If a connection drops mid-operation a message can briefly exist in both folders.
The server name is per customer. A name copied from someone else's guide, or the s1 shown on this page, connects only if your account happens to be on that server.

faq.q: Does Claude work with email hosted at cyber_Folks?
faq.a: Not on its own. Claude has no built-in cyber_Folks connector. Pointing an MCP server such as MCPEmails at the mailbox over IMAP gives Claude read, search, send, reply, schedule and organize access to it, and the same connection then works from Cursor, ChatGPT and other MCP clients.

faq.q: What are the cyber_Folks IMAP and SMTP settings?
faq.a: IMAP is your server, a name of the form s1.cyber-folks.pl with your own number, on port 993 with SSL. SMTP is the same server on port 465 with SSL, or 587 with STARTTLS, with authentication required. The username is your full address and the password is the mailbox password. cyber_Folks shows the server name under Dane konfiguracyjne in cyber_Admin.

faq.q: Where do I find my cyber_Folks mail server name?
faq.a: In cyber_Admin, behind the gear icon in the top right, under Dane konfiguracyjne, which lists the IMAP, POP3 and SMTP addresses and ports. Or in the Panel Klienta under Twoje usługi, Hosting, in the Host column next to your hosting service.

faq.q: Does cyber_Folks need an app password?
faq.a: No. cyber_Folks has no app-specific password scheme. The password set on the mailbox authenticates both IMAP and SMTP.

faq.q: Is my cyber_Folks mail stored on your servers?
faq.a: No. Messages are fetched live from your cyber_Folks server over IMAP for each request and handed to your AI client. Credentials are encrypted at rest and message bodies are not retained.
